title: Formal vs informal
description: Choose and switch register according to audience and context.

introduction.headline: Control your register
introduction.body: Distinguish casual and professional wording, and practise shifting tone without losing meaning.
introduction.bodyIt: Distingui formulazioni casual e professionali e pratica i cambi di tono senza perdere il significato.
objectives: Avoid register mismatch in professional settings

vocabulary.example: Email to clients usually requires formal register.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: Le email ai clienti di solito richiedono un registro formale.

vocabulary.example: Use formal language in board reports.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: Usa un linguaggio formale nei report per il consiglio.

vocabulary.example: Informal chat is fine among close colleagues.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: La chiacchiera informale va bene tra colleghi stretti.

vocabulary.example: Always adapt tone to your audience.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: Adatta sempre il tono al tuo pubblico.

options: I would agree with that assessment.
exercises.answer: I would agree with that assessment.
exercises.explanation: Assessment and would agree mark formal register.

exercises.prompt: Choosing the suitable ____ reflects awareness of audience and context.
exercises.promptIt: Completa: Choosing the suitable ____ reflects awareness of audience and context.
exercises.explanation: Register is the level of formality in language.

exercises.promptIt: Il registro dovrebbe principalmente corrispondere a...
exercises.explanation: Purpose and listeners determine suitable formality.

review.tip: Rewrite one casual message as a formal email of the same meaning.
